title: Recipe parsing, dependency closure and compilation
scope: Compile one source plus exact semantic dependency catalog, not execute a workflow.
proposed_work_bound: O(source/dependency bytes + dependency nodes/edges + emitted compiled bytes), plus G01 canonical ordering and declared validation-profile cost. Explicit expansion charged to output, but repeated copying of shared dependencies is not free.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Working memory O(source + unique dependency model + compiled output) for materialized API; no exponential expansion of shared reusable definitions.
semantic_requirement: Exact operation/interface/subrecipe pins, grammar errors, acyclicity and policy identity unaffected by scheduling choices.
proposed_witness: Long chain, diamond/shared dependencies, deeply nested source and repeated observer definitions; count copies and exact compiled bytes/digests.

title: Exact selection and immutable plan storage
scope: Build/iterate selected subject, evidence and target-plan sets.
proposed_work_bound: O(selection/evidence/plan bytes + members + explicit relation edges) plus indexed/order costs over complete construction. Loading one bounded summary independent of plan total.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(window) process state with O(plan data) immutable/disk state; no complete growing plan copy at every update.
semantic_requirement: Same declared meaning and exact selected members, complete plan commitment and reject unselected data; selectors retain their own semantics.
proposed_witness: Grow N with fixed recipe; count cumulative serialized/hashed bytes across planning checkpoints and status polls; compare exact plan membership after restart.

title: Logical observation delivery and batching
scope: Prepare and deliver exact named task selections, ports and predecessor disclosures using bounded reference-based observer input; one whole-scope semantic question remains one question.
proposed_work_bound: O(required task/port-subject incidences + actually delivered input/evidence bytes + physical delivery units), plus declared sorting/index/hash/schema costs. Whole-scope representation is segmented, not independent semantic batching; no repeated full request decode per control contact.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded read/write/parse/dispatch windows; retained immutable documents and durable per-step progress. Scoped metadata handles replace full subject/options/evidence tuples. No full-scope transaction or borrowed connection during evaluation/waiting.
semantic_requirement: Exact question/work identity independent of physical transport; request/job/claim identities distinct; whole-scope completeness, current authority, empty-scope rules, source-qualified members and original predecessor support preserved. Proposed v2 reference envelopes/validator ABI need owner acceptance; no extra scheduler or hidden result ceiling.
proposed_witness: Whole-scope provenance/filename pipeline with cross-chunk relations and differing selection/subject order; independent partitions, multiple tasks, empty, large single values, restart/fencing/auth/retention; native AST query and bounded lifecycle diagnostics are not production proof.

title: Observation acceptance and evidence/view indexing
scope: Independently validate exact observer source testimony into private indexed views, then publish acceptance only after complete schema/semantic/coverage checks.
proposed_work_bound: O(subjects + facts/source bytes + explicit record/view/edge/support incidences) logical work plus canonical ordering, indexed lookups and named schema/semantic costs. Shared unresolved-relation taint avoids subject*unusable-claim multiplication; no whole-evidence decode/hash/count in every poll or final publication.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded closeable input/value readers and private attempt/checkpoint state; output-sized source/index storage accounted. Segmented records/support; exact terminal metadata permits short accepted-pointer commit; bounded fenced cleanup.
semantic_requirement: Separate transport integrity, observer completion and controller acceptance. Preserve same-scope/global/status/endpoint meanings, source record order versus edge dedup, native selection commitments and scoped original testimony. Missing/invalid/indeterminate evidence is never a complete negative. Reviewed reference ABI retains exact logical JSON and independent validator authority.
proposed_witness: Last-page missing/extra/wrong-root, duplicate subjects, multi-record statuses, global subset, ambiguous endpoints, late unresolved-relation taint, exact retries/restarts, live disclosure checks and scoped custody/recovery. Native profiles/PG/runtime proof remains required beyond model and AST diagnostics.

title: Fact classification and predicate evaluation
scope: Evaluate a fixed declared recipe predicate set over accepted facts.
proposed_work_bound: Simple per-record predicates: O(P * (fact bytes + subjects)) with P explicitly the predicate size/count; fixed P yields linear collection work. Nested quantifiers/joins need a separate cost profile; cannot claim O(input+output) for every arbitrary predicate.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded per-record evaluation and disk-backed accepted fact views; no one copied corpus per predicate invocation.
semantic_requirement: Missing/partial/ambiguous evidence remains indeterminate or failure; same-record predicate scope and exact source evidence preserved.
proposed_witness: Absent matches, many records on one subject, nested predicate variants, fixed recipe vs increasing P separately; count evaluated pairs/records.

title: Relationship grouping and source association
scope: Build declared primary/associated groups from complete accepted relation evidence.
proposed_work_bound: O(subjects + supplied relation edges + emitted groups/members) logical traversal per fixed tier/predicate set, plus sorting/index costs. No all-primary*sidecar probe on a sparse exact-key relation.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded checkpoints with O(groups + actual edges) durable state; ambiguous evidence kept explicitly, not collapsed for speed.
semantic_requirement: Tier fallback only on complete negatives, exact multiplicity and unmatched/blocked outcomes preserved.
proposed_witness: Sparse one-to-one, ambiguous, shared and genuinely dense relations; no-match stress and interruption at tier/association/sealing boundaries.

title: Forks, joins and nested work
scope: Instantiate and settle an expanded execution tree over exact selected branch inputs.
proposed_work_bound: O(expanded invocation nodes + edges + selected input/output incidence bytes) plus indexing. A compact recipe expanding into many actual required calls is charged by expanded work, not misrepresented as linear in recipe text.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded coordination state per step; persisted state proportional to real invocation/selection tree, not repeated ancestor copies.
semantic_requirement: All matching branches, exact joins/export and no-output distinctions remain; one child state change does not force full tree decoding.
proposed_witness: Deep chain, broad fork, shared input selection, many completed siblings, join inapplicability and cancellation; count parent/child rows examined per transition.

title: Admission, preview/create binding and reconciliation
scope: Automatically admit or manually invoke exact work and converge across restart.
proposed_work_bound: O(new event/selection/plan evidence + applicable policy work) plus indexed lookups; same-request idempotency/current fence check must not recompute accepted immutable planning repeatedly.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded admission stages with durable identity/preview records; resource waits isolated from scheduler.
semantic_requirement: Recovered automatically admitted work actually executes and settles; manual convergence is not substitute end-to-end coverage.
proposed_witness: Offline catalog follower, intent/preview/work-bound restarts, manual duplicate convergence and one small automatically admitted completion path.

title: Target dispatch, leases, callbacks and accepted work
scope: Accept/queue/execute bounded control transitions around an exact target request.
proposed_work_bound: O(accepted declaration bytes once + real transitions/outputs + control observations*p), plus indexed access; no request-sized JSON reconstruction per poll/callback.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Configured worker/host-lease limits with bounded queued-step processing; immutable declarations held once or spooled, not copied across all active polls.
semantic_requirement: Single authority, host execution leases, cancellation and restart fencing; repeated contacts cannot create duplicate execution.
proposed_witness: Large accepted declaration with fixed poll count, then increasing polls; lost callback, queued lease/restart, independent host progress.

title: Output settlement, completion and source retirement
scope: Settle each exact target result and per-member disposition, then authorized root retirement.
proposed_work_bound: O(outputs + input-output links + result/evidence bytes + genuine transitions) plus indexed access and shared provenance validation once per exact corpus.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded settlement pages; persistent dispositions proportional to actual members/links. Parent completion reads maintained state rather than every output each poll.
semantic_requirement: No retirement before complete per-member evidence/permissions/grace; no implicit no-output/partial-success conflation.
proposed_witness: Many outputs sharing completion history, failed branch, duplicate settlement, late permission loss, restart and unchanged final collection IDs.

title: Evaluation variants and review orchestration
scope: Construct requested variant/sample evaluations and coordinate reviews.
proposed_work_bound: O(explicit variants*sample incidences + plan bytes + review records), plus ordering/index costs; independent axes disclosed. No claim linear in N alone if requested variants grow with N.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded active sample work with persisted evaluations proportional to requested outputs; large score/decision matrices paged.
semantic_requirement: Human-selected variants/results, complete samples and exact intent binding preserved; no selecting fewer variants to pass.
proposed_witness: Vary variants and samples independently; incomplete/duplicate sample result, rejection, re-review and restart; count matrix expansion and report bytes.
